rationale: This is unambiguously a motor vehicle collision claim — your vehicle was struck and sustained severe damage by another vehicle, and you sustained injury from the impact.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 AM, resulting in a totaled vehicle (trunk crushed into rear seat) and injury to the policyholder (whiplash, sprained wrist). Other driver's insurance information is available on the police report. High-severity collision requiring immediate assessment.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
